 Oklahoma City Thunder makes impact on the city and businesses 
 Local tourism leaders say the Thunder’s success can lead to big business for the city. The team’s success is giving Oklahoma City exposure that could attract more visitors and major events. As another Thunder season gets underway, that spotlight could mean more visitors spending money at local hotels, restaurants, and businesses. Visit Oklahoma City hopes the team’s excitement and the new season will lead to more visitors and major events.
